notes: An alert fires when its measured value is greater than or equal to a threshold. USD6 values are integer micro-USD strings. A null threshold disables that severity. Critical alerts make scripts/monitor.mjs exit 2.

uncaptured_overage.description: USD6 of provider cost that exceeded a reservation and could not be captured, recorded in the last window.

holds_stuck_reconciliation.description: Holds whose exact cost could not be confirmed and that have stayed in reconciliation_pending.

rate_limit_storm.description: Rate-limit buckets whose hit count reached the threshold inside the last window (429 storm or abuse).

deposit_intents_expired.description: USDC deposit intents still awaiting payment after their expiry; a paid deposit that was never credited looks like this.

token_deposit_intents_expired.description: Platform-token deposit intents still pending after their expiry.

jobs_stuck_running.description: Inference, media and import jobs still running after their lease expired (a worker or the maintenance job is not recovering them).

burn_reserve_drift.description: Absolute USD6 difference between the burn-reserve ledger balance and accrued fees minus executed burns.

migration_checksum_drift.description: Applied migrations that differ from the files in the deployed commit (checksum mismatch, missing or unknown migration).
